name: prctl
synopsis: int prctl(int op, ... /* unsigned long arg2, unsigned long arg3, unsigned long arg4, unsigned long arg5 */);
description: prctl() manipulates various aspects of the behavior of the calling thread or process, such as capabilities and floating-point modes. Careless use can confuse the user-space run-time environment, so it should be used with caution.

parameters.name: op
parameters.description: The operation to perform, defined in <linux/prctl.h>

parameters.name: arg2
parameters.description: Second argument, significance depends on the operation

parameters.name: arg3
parameters.description: Third argument, significance depends on the operation

parameters.name: arg4
parameters.description: Fourth argument, significance depends on the operation

parameters.name: arg5
parameters.description: Fifth argument, significance depends on the operation

return_value.success: Returns a value depending on the operation (e.g., 1, 0, or the current mode)
